entries.description: one object per firm/business entry in the directory, in printed top-to-bottom, left-to-right column order. each entry begins with a bold Latin-script name heading; the personnel/staff name lists printed under an entry are NOT separate entries and are not extracted. skip pure display advertisements and running-head fragments.

firmNameEnglish.description: the bold Latin-script firm or person name printed as the heading of the entry, transcribed verbatim including any trailing company abbreviation and initials as printed.

firmNameChinese.description: the Chinese-character (hanzi) shop name printed with the entry heading, transcribed in conventional reading order. these names are set in the traditional orientation that reads RIGHT-TO-LEFT across the printed line, so the first character to transcribe is the RIGHTMOST one printed and a trailing 公司 ('company') reads last; the romanized reading, when present, gives the correct character order. no spaces between characters. null if no hanzi name is printed.

firmNameRomanized.description: the italic romanized reading printed next to the hanzi name (a hyphenated syllable transliteration). transcribe verbatim as printed. null if none is printed.

address.description: the primary printed address: the street number + road/street name when a numbered street address is given (e.g. a house number followed by the road name); if only a named building or place is printed (no number+road), use that building/place name including its number if printed. exclude floor/room/apartment/suite parentheticals, alternative ('or ...') addresses, locality/district descriptors, and any secondary address line. null if no address is printed.

telephone.description: the telephone number or numbers printed after the entry's first 'Tel' label, as printed: preserve a trailing hyphenated range shorthand (e.g. a base number followed by '-N' or '-N-N' abbreviating consecutive numbers); join distinct full numbers in printed order separated by ', '. exclude separate residence ('Res') telephone lines and any parenthetical note. null if none is printed.

telegraphAddress.description: the cable / telegraphic address printed after the label 'TA', transcribed verbatim as printed. null if none is printed.
